result.notes: Public REST API (developer.systeme.io/reference, ~40 resources x CRUD = roughly 100-150 endpoints, so medium breadth) authenticated via X-API-Key header; keys are self-generated in dashboard Settings > MCP & API keys with no approval step, and the free plan (no credit card required) includes API/MCP key generation. Separately, systeme.io ships an official MCP server (mcp.systeme.io/mcp) authenticated with a key-based scheme (OAuth explicitly not yet supported per their docs), covering contacts, tags, and newsletters. No OAuth2/JWT/basic documented for the public API — key-only auth today.
result.one_liner: systeme.io is an all-in-one funnel builder and marketing platform (funnels, email campaigns, courses, ecommerce) offering a self-serve REST API and an official MCP server.
